text:
alex.g: heads-up — BigCo requested an emergency routing patch: they want any path under /api/v2/embeddings/* to short-circuit to their dedicated pool due to observed tail latency. asked legal for an SLA note but wanted engineering opinions before we touch routing rules. :eyes:
samantha.k: do we have an existing mechanism for per-customer path precedence without a full org header? iirc we rely on header pins or tenant-id in auth token, not raw path matching for enterprise exceptions.
lee_ops: we do path-based predicates but they're ranked lower than header-affinity. we could add a higher-priority path rule for BigCo, but that bypasses normal sticky/entropy rules — risk: other customers start asking.
dina_prod: product concern: console should show any ad-hoc path pins and their expiry. otherwise ops will get paged with “who added this?” every time.
ryan_product: agreed. if we accept, we should require TTL and audit reason. plus a one-click revoke in console rollout.
alex.g: proposed minimal rule (to be applied as a tenant-scoped exception):
```
match: path_prefix("/api/v2/embeddings/") && header("x-customer-id") == "bigco"
action: route_to_pool("bigco-dedicated-embeddings")
priority: 9000  # above default header pins
ttl: 72h
```
lee_ops: that looks fine technically. two operational notes: 1) KV cache isolation — ensure we don't re-use prefix caches across pools, else cost/accuracy problems. 2) telemetry: mark metrics with tag org=bigco and rule=path-exception so we can filter.
samantha.k: about audit — can audit-bot auto-open a ticket when such a rule is created? current policy requires manual form.
audit-bot: we can create a ticket automatically if rule creation call includes metadata fields `creator`, `reason`, and `ttl`. i'll need a small api change to accept them.
infra-bot: deploy-check: adaptive router currently supports numeric priority plus source (header,path). patch must be backwards compatible; add validation for `ttl` and `reason` in /v1/rules POST schema.
dina_prod: console UX: add a small banner on customer page showing "active routing exceptions" with expiry and reassign owner. also allow create rule flow to suggest alternatives (cache pin, model-variant pin) so we avoid path proliferation.
ryan_product: can we make the console enforce a max of N ad-hoc path rules per org? or at least warn when >1.
lee_ops: warn is easier. limit could cause customer friction. but enforceable soft-limit + billing note (premium support) works.
alex.g: security question — path-exception combined with permissive CORS could open cross-tenant access if we rely on headers only. make sure auth still verifies tenant.
samantha.k: +1. rule should never bypass auth. it only affects routing after auth decision. add a test in our integration suite that simulates forged headers.
lee_ops: i'll draft the router PR with schema changes and tests. target: staging by EOD tomorrow. if audit-bot can wire ticket creation, we can demo console flow in next week's eng-platform sync.
dina_prod: i'll sketch the console panel and mock the revoke flow. include an "escalate to security" button.
audit-bot: ticket template: title="Routing exception created (org=bigco)", fields=[creator, reason, ttl, rule_id, approver(if any)]. auto-attach metric sample for 24h pre-change.
alex.g: thanks all. i'll wait for the PR and console mock. please keep messages brief in the PR so we can fast-track review. :thumbsup:
